description:
This is a DRAFT solicitation for industry questions and comments for the Department of Veterans Affairs Transition Assistance Program. 

The formal Solicitation will be issued on GSA. This draft Solicitation is for questions and comments only. No offers will be accepted in response to this draft solicitation. 

Questions and Comments are due to Rebecca.Ubert@va.gov and Roxana.Cepeda@va.gov on 15 MAY 2026 at 4pm EST.
